sloka: अथ ताम् जात सम्तापाम् तेन वाक्येन मोदिताम् ।सरमा ह्लादयाम् आस महीं दग्धामिवाम्भसा ॥६-३४-१॥।।
transliteration: atha tām jāta samtāpām tena vākyena moditām ।saramā hlādayām āsa mahīṁ dagdhāmivāmbhasā ॥6-34-1॥।।

translations.english: Thus, Sita's agony was put off by Saarana's consoling words and Sita was glad just as the parched earth was delighted with shower of rain.
